notes.title: Update: Custom Mode and Brazilian Portuguese support
notes.content:
Hey Dashers,

it's been a while and things happend behind closed doors. We are happy that with today's update Custom Mode becomes available. You can now personalize some parameters of your runs.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37346399/68389b56798071cc82e0dc04cc5da2cae5e4edcc.png

Our gang of Dashers also learned a new language: brazilian portuguese. Many thanks to Guilherme! ːsteamhappyː 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37346399/f4c3372148595de4f35a042e4008b1ea4be63ca7.png

PATCHNOTES 25.03.2021
===============================

 Added brazilian portuguese
 Added Custom Mode. You can set the number of levels per run, dash speed, dash distance, run speed and damage by yourself. It is also possible to randomize enemies.

notes.title: New update for xDasher available!
notes.content:
PATCHNOTES 27.10.2020
===============================
GENERAL

 Performing a rescue dash (dashing when directly over a pit) should now be easier
 Added a keyboard only control scheme
 The one handed control scheme now comes in 2 variations: left and right
 Added Steam rich presence support so you can see what your friends are up to

LEVEL DESIGN
 Added general balancing changes in level design of 1 and 2 player levels

ENEMIES

 The bombs spawned by the Quadhead enemy have received tiny wings to be used when placed on a pit

BOSS

 Fixed a misplaced head in bossfight

AUDIO

 Added SFX for evaporating boss head after fight
 Fixed an issue where UI SFX were not muted

LEADERBOARDS

 Scrolling up and down the leaderboards with the mouse wheel should no longer take forever

OPTIONS

 Added the 'Particles' option to set the maximum number of destruction particles.

notes.title: Dash, fight & fail together!
notes.content:
This is xDasher. 

A game about dashing through enemies with the proper colour to get higher combos and score - and a game without any story twaddle.

In times of physical distancing you can compete on the global leaderboard in single player mode or play with up to 3 far away friends via Remote Play Together.

This demo features a couple of levels for single and multiplayer sessions. We also freshly reset the leadboards for the festival, so every new player and veteran dasher gets a chance to claim the first place.  


We are Pixel Beef Games. 

We love beef and we love pixels! 

Lena, Sven, and Peter are three students of computer game studies at the University of Bayreuth, Germany. There, our journey started, at the Franconian Game Jam 2019. The theme “Back to the couch” inspired us to come up with the idea of a classic couch co-op game where the players must work together to win. This was the beginning of xDasher. Now, one year later, it's time to invite you. Be welcome fellow dasher and become part of our adventure. <3

notes.title: Demo patch version 255
notes.content:
Please note the following changes to the xDasher Demo:

- Barrel stability has been reduced by 500% so players can walk right through them.
- Barriers have been patched up and projectiles should no longer go through them.
- Getting stuck inside barriers should now definitely be impossible.
- Added a retry button, so go and get that perfect run!
- All menus should now be displayed properly when using a 4K resolution.
- New player spawn animations will blow your mind!
- Leaderboards have been reset.

notes.title: Our xDasher demo is now available!
notes.content:
Grab your friends
Remember the days where you could visit your friends and play some cool co-op games? Well, we can't make Corona go away, but we can bring you some fun with the demo of our beloved xDasher. Take a first look of our game based on couch and cooperation. So grab your best friends (with a safety distance of 1.5m) or try the singleplayer mode. 

Brag with your highscore
Show us and the whole world your highscore in our global leaderboard. Tweet a screenshot of your victory, tag us @xDasherGame and we'll retweet it!

Let us know if you liked it or if you have any feedback for us! ːsteamhappyː

Pro Tipp: You can play online with your friends by using Remote Play Together on Steam!
